about: schema 2: one entry per registry block (sorted by name), one line per valid block state (sorted by properties); props = state property values; boxes = entity-vs-block collision boxes for this state in isolation (air neighbours, no entity), relative to the block origin, [minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ]; slipperiness = Block.slipperiness as a raw float; climbable = Block.isLadder; solid = Block.isSideSolid mask, bit EnumFacing.ordinal() (DOWN,UP,NORTH,SOUTH,WEST,EAST); connector = generated connection facts (kind fence/wall/pane/gate, group, cube = opaque+isFullCube+not gourd, pane = canPaneConnectToBlock). File is UTF-8 with LF line endings.
